svg.title: Where the Raw Lead Leaks
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-raw-lead-leakage-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: Where the Raw Lead Leaks; subtitle: Intake quality versus retainer reality, in percent of raw leads; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Raw leads entering intake; value: 100; display: 100% baseline; conversion: Starting pool before congruence checks and TrustedForm; detail: Case Works runs email and phone congruence checks plus TrustedForm so bad leads die before workup, the largest cost in the chain.; label: Qualified on a working intake floor; value: 70; display: 70%, can reach 80-85%; conversion: 140 of 200 qualified out of 600 leads; detail: Alert Communications benchmark from a 425-staff intake operation that adjusts staffing every 15 minutes.; label: Qualified on a broken intake floor; value: 40; display: Only 20-40%; conversion: Same leads, broken intake; detail: Alert Communications contrasts its floor with broken intake that converts only 20% to 40%.; label: Retainers on one niche tort; value: 16; display: 16%; conversion: Best-case raw-lead-to-retainer; detail: John Casto reports one niche tort converting at 16% with payouts of a couple thousand dollars.; label: Typical raw-lead retainers; value: 4; display: 3-4%; conversion: Typical raw-lead-to-retainer, before 20-40% attrition; detail: Casto's typical conversion; a DQ filter doubled CPL with no lift. Devin Downey measured about 30% attrition from 2020 to 2024 on signed cases.; caption: The signed retainer is the wrong finish line; cost per retained, settlement-ready case is the number that matters.; assumptions note: Stages combine separate practitioner benchmarks on one percent scale and are not a single measured cohort. Signed-case CPA spans $300 to six grand or more.; note: Sources: Advanced Affiliate with John Casto (Tt2FvNxVuCs), Alert Communications (PJEVefyQCxA), Case Works with Devin Downey (My_I0OLHPXc), Blue Sky Legal (n9AQhSIMkNg).

rect.title: label: Raw leads entering intake; value: 100; display: 100% baseline; conversion: Starting pool before congruence checks and TrustedForm; detail: Case Works runs email and phone congruence checks plus TrustedForm so bad leads die before workup, the largest cost in the chain.

label: Qualified on a working intake floor; value: 70; display: 70%, can reach 80-85%; conversion: 140 of 200 qualified out of 600 leads; detail: Alert Communications benchmark from a 425-staff intake operation that adjusts staffing every 15 minutes.

text.title: Qualified on a working intake floor: 70

rect.title: label: Qualified on a broken intake floor; value: 40; display: Only 20-40%; conversion: Same leads, broken intake; detail: Alert Communications contrasts its floor with broken intake that converts only 20% to 40%.

text.title: Qualified on a broken intake floor: 40

rect.title: label: Retainers on one niche tort; value: 16; display: 16%; conversion: Best-case raw-lead-to-retainer; detail: John Casto reports one niche tort converting at 16% with payouts of a couple thousand dollars.

label: Typical raw-lead retainers; value: 4; display: 3-4%; conversion: Typical raw-lead-to-retainer, before 20-40% attrition; detail: Casto's typical conversion; a DQ filter doubled CPL with no lift. Devin Downey measured about 30% attrition from 2020 to 2024 on signed cases.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages combine separate practitioner benchmarks on one percent scale and are not a single measured cohort. Signed-case CPA spans $300 to six grand or more.

CPA spans $300 to six grand or more.
